title: FNOclass: seismic event classification with a lightweight Fourier Neural Operator model
description: FNOclass is an implementation of a lightweight deep learning model for seismic event classification based on the Fourier Neural Operator (FNO). The method is designed for efficient and accurate classification of seismic waveforms, particularly in resource-constrained and real-time monitoring environments.
